meta.title: Florensia: free-to-play anime MMORPG
meta.description: Play Florensia for free: an anime MMORPG where you fight on land and sail the seas with your guild.

home.tagline: Free-to-play anime MMORPG. Fight on land, sail the seas and build your guild.

hero.artAlt: A Magic Knight heroine in an orange and black dress

land.title: Fight on land
land.body: Explore islands full of monsters, dungeons and quests, solo or with friends.

sea.title: Sail the seas
sea.body: Captain your own ship, fight naval battles and discover new shores.

guild.title: Join a guild
guild.body: Team up with other players, conquer territory and climb the rankings together.

classes.title: Choose your class
classes.intro: Four classes, eight paths. At level {level}, each class picks one of two specializations.

mercenary.description: A frontline warrior in heavy armour who takes the hits and protects the party with sword and shield.

explorer.description: Quick and resourceful, fights from a distance with firearms and gadgets and digs up treasure across the islands.

noble.description: Masters the arcane arts: mighty spells from afar or an enchanted blade up close.

saint.description: Heals wounds, strengthens allies and turns the tide of battle with sacred and nature magic.

download.title: Download Florensia
download.description: Download Florensia for free on Windows through Steam. System requirements, size and installation steps.
download.intro: Florensia is free to play on Windows 10 or later. Install it through Steam in a few minutes.

recommendation.windows: Your computer runs Windows: you can play
recommendation.windowsBody: Install Florensia from Steam. The download is about {size} GB.
recommendation.desktopBody: The game is only available for Windows 10 or later. You can still add it to your Steam library now and install it from a Windows PC.
recommendation.mobileBody: Open this page on your Windows computer to install it. You can add it to your Steam library from your phone now.
recommendation.unknownBody: The game is available for Windows 10 or later through Steam.

requirements.title: System requirements
requirements.note: Intel integrated graphics older than the 7th generation might not be supported.

steps.title: How to install
steps.one: Install Steam and sign in, or create a free Steam account.
steps.two: Open Florensia in Steam and press Play.
steps.three: Create your Florensia account in the game launcher and choose a server.

support.title: Support
support.description: Answers to frequent questions about Florensia: account, payments, installation and rules.
support.intro: Find quick answers here. If your question is not listed, ask the community on Discord.

free.question: Is Florensia free?
free.answer: Yes. The game is free to play. The shop sells optional items with AP, the shop currency.

system.question: Which computer do I need?
system.answer: Windows 10 or later. The download page lists the minimum and recommended requirements.

ap.question: What is AP and how do I get it?
ap.answer: AP is the currency of the item shop. You top it up from your account and your balance is shown on every purchase.

password.question: I forgot my password
password.answer: Use the password recovery link on the sign-in page. You will receive an email with a link that works only once.

report.question: How do I report a player?
report.answer: Note the character name, server and time, take a screenshot if you can and send it to support. The rules explain what is not allowed.

migration.question: Can I move my character to another server?
migration.answer: Character migration is handled by support. Include your account name, the character and the target server in your request.

support.communityBody: The Florensia community and team answer questions on the official Discord server.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.exportBody: Download a JSON file with everything we store about your account: account data, characters, purchases, top-ups, AP movements, redeemed codes and sessions.
privacy.deleteBody: Your account name, email and password will be deleted, all your sessions will be closed and your characters will no longer be linked to this account. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteKept: By law we keep the record of purchases, top-ups and AP movements, without your name or email.
privacy.deleteConfirm: I understand that my account will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
privacy.deleted: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for playing Florensia.

errors.confirm: Tick the box to confirm that you want to delete your account.

verify.subject: Confirm your Florensia account
verify.body: Thank you for creating your account. Confirm your email address by opening this link:
verify.note: The link expires in 24 hours. If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Florensia password
reset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Choose a new one by opening this link:
reset.note: The link expires in 30 minutes and can only be used once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password does not change.

existing.subject: Someone tried to register with your email
existing.body: Someone tried to create a Florensia account with this email address, but you already have one. If it was you, simply sign in:
existing.note: If you have forgotten your password, use “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page. If it was not you, you can ignore this email.

newEmail.subject: Confirm your new Florensia email
newEmail.body: You asked to use this email for your Florensia account. Confirm it by opening this link:
newEmail.note: The link expires in 24 hours. Until you open it, your account keeps using the previous email. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

emailChange.subject: A change of your account email was requested
emailChange.body: Someone signed in to your Florensia account asked to change its email to {email}. It will only change if the link sent to that address is opened.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Florensia password has changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your Florensia account has just changed, and your sessions on other devices have been closed.

notMe.action: It was not me: recover my account
notMe.note: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password now: all sessions will be closed.
